svg.title: Keep the Core Pod Small and Add Two Seats Deliberately
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-domain-investing-pod-seats; chart type: org_architecture; title: Keep the Core Pod Small and Add Two Seats Deliberately; subtitle: Two core people; four people only in the scaled scenario.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Conservative and Base use one full-time owner plus one contractor. Scaled uses two full-time people plus two contractors. Each stage represents one person; the last two seats are additions, not hidden Base-Case staffing.; caption: The owner retains bid limits, pricing authority, registrar control, and payout verification. Contractors receive only the access required for their assigned work.; stages: label: Core owner; value: 1 FT; acquisition and commercial authority; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Set portfolio budgets and bid ceilings, review rights risks, negotiate sales, control registrar credentials, and reconcile escrow releases.; label: Core research contractor; value: 1 C; evidence and inventory operations; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain comparable-sale records and renewal calendars; use spreadsheets or SQLite for inventory tracking without authority to transfer domains.; label: Scaled sales operator; value: Add 1 FT; buyer pipeline ownership; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Handle inbound inquiry routing, qualification, documented offers, and lawful outbound upgrades within the owner's written pricing limits.; label: Scaled operations contractor; value: Add 1 C; monitoring and reconciliation support; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Automate renewal reminders and comparable-sale monitoring; audit listing consistency and transaction records without unilateral payout or transfer access.
